briefing: A survey pilot is adrift out there, one jump out from {HERE}. Find her pod, scoop her clear, and bring her home alive.
{PATRON} does not care how it is done. Just land her safe at a station and the pay is yours.
dossier.lead: {PATRON} at {WORLD} has left word for the commander to call.

pod.arrive: Scoop the drifting pod at {TARGET} and get her aboard
pod.success: The pod is aboard alive, {PAY} is yours
pod.fail: The pod is gone, and the deal is off

data.arrive: Take what data survived back to {TARGET}
data.success: The data reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} is paid
data.fail: The data never reached {TARGET}, no pay

dossier.news: {WORLD} station news: {PATRON} is offering pay for the safe return of a lost pilot

rumour.far: Word round the bars says {PATRON} at {WORLD} still needs a lost pilot found.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: a pilot is still out there, unclaimed.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took a rescue job for a drifting pilot near {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the missing pilot was home safe, and the job was closed.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the rescue had failed, and the pilot's trail off {WORLD} went cold.

pod.survivor:landed: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the drifting pilot was pulled in alive.
pod.survivor:sold: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the rescued pilot was sold instead of freed.
pod.targetDestroyed: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the pod was destroyed before it could be scooped.
pod.failed: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the rescue at the pod ran out of time.

data.success: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the recovered survey data was delivered as promised.
data.failed: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the recovered data never reached its destination.

dossier.title: The Pilot Adrift
